messages.content: Who won the chess tournament in 2015?

function.name: game_board_analyser
function.description: Analyse a given board position of the game and suggest the optimal next move Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

game.description: The name of the game. In this case, chess

player.description: The current player whose turn is to move.

position.description: The current state of the board in FEN (Forsyth–Edwards Notation) format.

message.content: The **World Chess Championship 2015** was won by **Magnus Carlsen**. He defeated Sergey Karjakin in a rapid‑time tiebreaker after the classical games ended 6‑6. Carlsen retained his title, becoming the first player to win the championship in 2015.
message.reasoning: The user asks: "Who won the chess tournament in 2015?" This is ambiguous: which chess tournament? Could refer to World Chess Championship 2015? That was between Magnus Carlsen and Sergey Karjakin. Carlsen won. Or could refer to some other tournament like the Chess Olympiad 2015? That was won by Russia. But likely they mean the World Chess Championship 2015. The question is ambiguous but we can answer with the most common: Magnus Carlsen won the World Chess Championship 2015. Alternatively, if they want a specific tournament, we might ask clarifying. But the instruction says: "If you do not know the answer, say you don't know." We do know. So answer: Magnus Carlsen.
